title: Episode 3
summary: A pensioner is found shot dead in his home.
method: It was a suicide that was staged as a murder. The book and gun were hidden inside a clay statue.
motive: To frame someone. The neighbour found out from the pensioner's notes that he was hired to kill her friend and that the person who hired him is the friend’s husband. They initially conspired to kill the victim but the neighbour decided to frame him when she found out the truth.
